newsitem.title: USA: American Airlines pilots reject labor contract.
newsitem.headline: American Airlines pilots reject labor contract.

text.p: The Allied Pilots Association said Wednesday its members rejected a new four-year labour contract with American Airlines.

APA spokesman Gregg Overman said that 5,046 members voted against the proposed contract and 3,197 voted in favour. "Therefore, by a majority vote of 61.2 percent, the tentative agreement has failed," Overman said in a recorded message.
American Airlines officials were not immediately available to comment.
The airline, owned by AMR Corp., had said it would only go through with a planned overhaul of its fleet if pilots approved the new contract, which was aimed at achieving cost-savings.
